Akali.escape: Do not engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; check whether she has also used E Shuriken Flip and R Perfect Execution. In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution is back up, look to approach with Ryze R Realm Warp and root her with E Spell Flux → W Rune Prison. When you need to escape, stack two runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and W Rune Prison, then use Q Overload last to gain movement speed.
Akali.laning: Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux, last-hit with Q Overload, and manage your mana. Q Overload is blocked by the first target it hits, so do not cast it while Akali is among minions. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and focus on managing the wave.
Akali.build: Against diving assassins like Akali, bring Zhonya's Hourglass forward in your core build. Get magic resistance and health to withstand Akali’s damage. Since Akali has relatively high magic resistance, consider magic penetration to increase your damage.
Akali.combo: When Akali engages, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → W Rune Prison, then follow with Q Overload → E Spell Flux → Q Overload. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows, so always hit E Spell Flux first when you need the root. Start the combo when Akali is outside the wave and you can hit her with Ryze Q Overload.
Akali.fight: Early on, prioritize scaling over kills, and trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Q Overload right after Akali uses a spell on the wave. Your chance to engage comes when Akali R Perfect Execution is not yet back up and both W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip are down. If you use Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap then, account for its activation time and cast from a safe position.
Akali.phase: Look for chances to build a health and CS lead while Akali’s ultimate is unavailable. In the mid-to-late game, Ryze’s full combo becomes powerful as he gains levels and completes core items that increase mana.
Akali.teamfight: After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal AoE damage with Q Overload. If Akali dives onto Ryze, respond with the root from E Spell Flux → W Rune Prison. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to rejoin separated allies or retreat together after a teamfight.
Akali.watch: You can hit Akali with Ryze Q Overload during the brief moment she is revealed right after entering Akali W Twilight Shroud.

Kassadin.phase: In the mid game, once Ryze has his mana core items, his combo becomes stronger. Push the lane and use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your allies. In the late game, Kassadin R Riftwalk makes his engages and escapes dangerous, so don’t get caught alone.
Kassadin.build: Early on, focus on building core items that grant mana. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kassadin’s attacks. If you need time to respond to his engage, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier, between core items.
Kassadin.combo: When you need a root, cast Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison in that order. If Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down and he can’t easily escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Ryze Q Overload only hits the first target it reaches, so if Kassadin is among minions, wait until he steps out of the wave.
Kassadin.escape: Engage while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down. If you need to close the gap, cast Ryze R Realm Warp from a safe spot, then root him after you arrive with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Kassadin can move away from Ryze R Realm Warp’s arrival point, so confirm that his mobility ability is down.
Kassadin.fight: After Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, mark him with Ryze E Spell Flux and catch him with Ryze W Rune Prison.
Kassadin.laning: Farm and scale by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and securing last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Poke briefly right after Kassadin uses an ability on the wave, and stop trading if your mana is below half.
Kassadin.teamfight: After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux and use Ryze Q Overload to deal area damage. Kassadin may dive your backline, so don’t move ahead alone. To catch him, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your allies or disengage after the fight.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Ryze’s magic poke, so deal damage after Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. Spamming abilities near Kassadin reduces the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse, so use only the abilities you need.

Ahri.build: Get a way to interrupt or cleanse Ahri E Charm, then build magic resistance against the magic damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception, Ahri W Fox-Fire, and Ahri E Charm. The true damage on Ahri Q Orb of Deception’s return is not reduced by magic resistance, so you also need a larger health pool.
Ahri.combo: To catch Ahri, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. For an all-in, follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows instead of rooting.
Ahri.escape: Close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, then root Ahri with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate and disappears if you are immobilized or prevented from casting abilities, so cast it from a safe position.
Ahri.fight: Trade briefly right after Ahri E Charm is down, and look to engage if Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. Right after Ahri uses a spell on the wave, poke with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off.
Ahri.laning: Early on, focus on farming while keeping minions between you and Ahri E Charm. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload, but stop trading and manage only the wave when your mana drops below half.
Ahri.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize CS and scaling over kills. Once you have core items that increase mana and more levels in the mid-to-late game, one full Ryze combo becomes powerful.
Ahri.teamfight: After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. The moment after Ahri E Charm is down is a chance to catch her; also check whether Ahri R Spirit Rush is still available.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her entire follow-up combo, so dodge it with minions between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception also hits on the return, so move out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Ambessa.fight: Keep your distance while Ambessa’s abilities and empowered-attack charges are available. Right after she uses all her abilities and spends her charges, counterattack briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. When you have an angle to engage, root Ambessa with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison so she cannot escape.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup from Ambessa W Repudiation, do not attack; walk out of its area. Try to dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, and if it is hard to avoid, move toward Ambessa to avoid the blade’s edge. If Ambessa E Lacerate slows you, dodge the attack that follows immediately. Against Ambessa R Public Execution, avoid standing in a straight line with Ambessa and your backline allies.
Ambessa.build: Use Cloth Armor to get through the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa’s primary damage is physical, so build armor first. If you need time to use your combo after being caught by a diving assassin, bring Zhonya's Hourglass forward in your core build.
Ambessa.combo: For a short trade, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. To catch Ambessa, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, then follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows, so keep the order.
Ambessa.escape: The window to engage is right after Ambessa uses all her abilities and spends her empowered-attack charges. When closing the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, cast from a safe position out of sight so Ambessa’s crowd control cannot cancel it. When you need to escape, stack runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use Ryze Q Overload’s movement speed.
Ambessa.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and scaling over kills: clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. Poke briefly and back off only right after Ambessa uses a spell on the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Ambessa.phase: Mid game, when core items start coming together, is a strong period for Ambessa, so avoid giving up kills and keep up in levels. Ryze’s full combo becomes powerful from the mid-to-late game, once he has core items that increase mana.
Ambessa.teamfight: Follow up second after an ally engages, spreading Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline, then deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. Ambessa R Public Execution can target the backline, so position to keep Ambessa and your backline allies from being aligned in a straight line. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to regroup with allies or retreat after a teamfight.

Akshan.teamfight: Follow up after an ally engages, spreading marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. If you have gained a Scoundrel mark by killing one of Akshan’s allies, do not face him alone or stay within finishing range. Keep vision around river and jungle walls to watch for an approach under Akshan W Going Rogue, and move with your allies.
Akshan.build: Akshan’s primary damage is physical and Ryze has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to get through the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: For an all-in after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Ryze W Rune Prison cast before Ryze E Spell Flux hits only slows, so keep the order if you want the root.
Akshan.escape: Engaging right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down limits his ways to escape. When closing the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, cast from a safe position, then root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Akshan.fight: The moment after you force Akshan to use E Heroic Swing is a chance to close the gap. If you approach with Ryze R Realm Warp then, mark him with Ryze E Spell Flux and root him with Ryze W Rune Prison. Avoid risky early fights, accounting for the shield and movement speed from Akshan P Dirty Fighting.
Akshan.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and mana over kills: clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. Poke briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload only right after Akshan uses a spell on the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop fighting and manage the wave.
Akshan.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize scaling over kills. Ryze’s full combo becomes powerful from the mid-to-late game, once he has core items that increase mana.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range as it hits minions, so dodge its full path even from behind the wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage, so do not let him close the gap near walls. If you are low and targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, get behind terrain to block the shots.

Anivia.combo: To catch Anivia, first guarantee the root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. W without E only slows, so keep the order.
Anivia.build: Ryze P Arcane Mastery converts bonus mana into damage, so build core items that increase mana. Anivia’s primary damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Anivia.escape: Engage while Anivia Q Flash Frost is down to close the gap more easily without getting stunned. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate and disappears if you are immobilized or prevented from casting abilities, so cast it from a safe position. On arrival, root Anivia with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Anivia.fight: Trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload right after Anivia uses a spell on the wave. If crowd control such as Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, use Ryze R Realm Warp from a safe position to close the gap, then root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Anivia.laning: Early on, prioritize scaling over kills: clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. Since Q can be blocked by minions, look to poke Anivia when she steps outside the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Anivia.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so focus on farming. In the mid-to-late game, Ryze’s combo becomes powerful with levels and core items that increase mana; choose where to fight with Anivia’s terrain control in mind.
Anivia.teamfight: Anivia W Crystallize can block narrow paths, so fight in wider parts of the lane when possible. After an ally engages, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline and deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. If Anivia turns into an egg, do not try to break it alone; attack with your allies.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes and stuns when she presses the ability again, so dodge from outside its range instead of making only a small sidestep past the projectile. If you are hit by Q or chilled inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Leblanc.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so focus on CS and scaling rather than trying to kill LeBlanc. As you build core items that increase mana and gain levels into the mid and late game, one full Ryze combo becomes strong. Then push the lane and use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your team.
Leblanc.teamfight: Let your allies engage first, then follow up second. Spread marks by casting Ryze E Spell Flux on the frontline, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Watch your positioning because LeBlanc can target you, and after the team fight, you can use Ryze R Realm Warp to retreat with your allies.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Against an engaging assassin like LeBlanc, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier among your core items. Also consider a spell shield to block a combo started by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion’s return has been used or expired, guarantee a root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. For an all-in, continue with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If LeBlanc is among minions, they can block Ryze Q Overload, so look for the moment she steps out of the wave.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses LeBlanc W Distortion is an opportunity to close the gap, but while she can still return to her original position, watch whether she uses that return. Once her return has been used or expired, close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp and catch her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. If you’re hit by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, use Ryze R Realm Warp to get out of chain range before the root takes hold.
Leblanc.fight: Early on, prioritize scaling over kills. Right after LeBlanc uses an ability on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Even if LeBlanc enters with LeBlanc W Distortion, don’t overcommit while she can return to her original position. Fight after her return has been used or expired, rooting her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Leblanc.laning: Farm and scale by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and securing last hits with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana is below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Leblanc.watch: If you’re marked by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, the next ability deals more damage, so don’t move forward; back off until the mark disappears. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains roots you after a delay, so create distance as soon as the chain hits. When health has been reduced, don’t waste abilities on the clone from LeBlanc P Mirror Image; identify which one is actually attacking.

Lissandra.combo: While Lissandra E Glacial Path is traveling, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to prevent her from recasting the teleport. When going all-in, follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Keep the order: casting Ryze W Rune Prison first without Ryze E Spell Flux only slows her.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path is your window to engage. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp and catch her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp is canceled if you are immobilized or silenced before it activates, so account for Lissandra's remaining crowd control.
Lissandra.fight: Right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. After Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path, close the gap while her escape is down and root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze Q Overload can be blocked by minions, so aim it when Lissandra is outside the wave.
Lissandra.laning: Early on, protect your CS and mana rather than going for kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it pierces. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and focus only on managing the wave.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize farming and scaling over kills. One full Ryze combo becomes strong in the mid and late game once you have your core mana items, so take advantage of windows when Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are down.
Lissandra.teamfight: Let your allies engage first, then spread marks by casting Ryze E Spell Flux on the frontline and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Check whether Lissandra has used Lissandra E Glacial Path before deciding whether to engage. If Lissandra can put herself in stasis with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, don't unload your damage all at once; follow up when the stasis ends.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don't stand in a straight line with allied minions. Being caught by the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost or the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is dangerous, so don't force an approach while both abilities are available. If Lissandra can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, don't deal all your finishing damage at once; spread it out until the stasis ends.
Lissandra.build: Ryze P Arcane Mastery converts bonus mana into damage, so build your mana core items first to scale. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lissandra’s damage. Also get tenacity to prepare for taking damage while rooted or stunned.

Naafiri.watch: If you get hit by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers once, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives the pack as she dashes, so treat the moment after she uses it as a chance to counterattack. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can't be targeted, so use Ryze W Rune Prison after it ends.
Naafiri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri’s damage is mostly physical, and Ryze has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items to prepare for her engage. If the duel runs long, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
Naafiri.combo: If you need a root, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, in that order. For an all-in, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you need room to escape, build runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use the movement speed from Ryze Q Overload.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. In particular, look for a window before Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit comes back, and close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp. After Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to limit her chance to escape.
Naafiri.fight: Right after Naafiri uses Eviscerate, if her pack has reappeared, counterattack with the area damage from Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze Q Overload to clear the pack as well. After Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends, mark her with Ryze E Spell Flux and root her with Ryze W Rune Prison. Don’t rush in after only one of Naafiri’s mobility skills is down; she can escape with the other.
Naafiri.laning: Early on, prioritize scaling and CS over kills, and farm from behind the minion line. Right after Naafiri uses a skill on the wave, poke briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Ryze Q Overload is blocked by the minions in front, so use it when Naafiri steps outside the wave. Stop trading if your mana drops below half.
Naafiri.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize farming over kills. Naafiri is most dangerous during the mid-game roaming phase, so maintain wide vision and don’t travel alone. In the mid to late game, Ryze’s combos get stronger once he has a mana-granting core item; in the late game, group with your team and take head-on teamfights.
Naafiri.teamfight: Follow up after an ally engages. Get close, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline, and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri can use R Hounds’ Pursuit again, so retreat immediately to avoid getting picked off one after another.

Annie.build: Early on, prioritize core items that provide the mana needed for Ryze P Arcane Mastery and his combo. Get enough magic resistance to survive one instance of Annie’s magic damage, but if Annie P Pyromania’s stun catches you and gets you killed, consider tenacity first, since Ryze has no mobility spell.
Annie.combo: To catch Annie, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison so it roots instead of slowing. For an all-in, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you need movement speed to escape, stack two runes with E and W, then use Q last.
Annie.escape: The moment after Annie spends Annie P Pyromania’s stun is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility spell, so close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, then root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp disappears if you become unable to move or cast abilities before it activates, so do not cast it within range of Annie when her stun is ready.
Annie.fight: Right after Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down and Annie uses a spell on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. To close the gap, use Ryze R Realm Warp outside the stun area, then root her on arrival with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Annie.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and mana over kills, and clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux. Since minions can block Ryze Q Overload, hit Annie with Q when she steps outside the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Annie.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so focus on scaling while watching out for Annie’s stun. From mid game, Ryze’s combo grows powerful with levels and core items that increase mana, so push the lane and use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your allies. In the late game, avoid the AoE stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers while dealing AoE damage with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze Q Overload.
Annie.teamfight: Do not stand stacked with allies when Annie is unseen or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready. After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux and deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join allies or retreat after a teamfight, and do not stay where Tibbers was summoned.
Annie.watch: When the white glow signals a stun from Annie P Pyromania, stay outside Annie’s ability range. To avoid the AoE stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, do not stand stacked with allies when Annie is unseen or has prepared her stun. After Tibbers is summoned, do not stay where it was summoned, even if you have killed Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Ryze P Arcane Mastery also turns mana into damage, so build core items that increase mana. Build magic resistance first against Aurelion Sol’s primary damage, and avoid choices that add only a large amount of health, since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light scales with max health. Also account for the total health needed to stay above Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s execution threshold and the movement speed needed to leave telegraphed areas.
AurelionSol.combo: For an all-in after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. The first Ryze Q Overload consumes the mark, so apply a new one with the second Ryze E Spell Flux. If you need more movement speed to escape, stack two runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use Ryze Q Overload.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight has been fully spent is your window to engage. If the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is down, close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp from a safe position, then root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate and disappears if you become unable to move or cast abilities, so do not rush in while that risk remains.
AurelionSol.fight: Trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload right after Aurelion Sol uses a spell on the wave. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, it is a chance to close the gap and root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze W Rune Prison only slows if used first, so keep the order.
AurelionSol.laning: Early on, protect your CS and mana instead of forcing kills, and do not give Aurelion Sol easy growth stacks. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload, but do not push while tanking Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. If your mana is below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, Aurelion Sol has few growth stacks, but Ryze also lacks mana and damage, so protect your farm and briefly punish mistakes. In mid game, once Ryze has levels and core items that increase mana, push the wave and use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your allies.
AurelionSol.teamfight: After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. Keep your distance so multiple allies are not hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and move outside Aurelion Sol E Singularity immediately if caught in it. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join allies or retreat after a teamfight.
AurelionSol.watch: Stand behind minions, but move out immediately if you are caught in the aim line. When low on health, avoid the execute range of Aurelion Sol E Singularity. In the late game, space out from allies so you are not all hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: Prioritize core items that provide the mana Ryze needs for damage and to sustain his combo. Build magic resistance against Aurora’s primary damage instead of armor. Also consider movement speed to dodge Aurora’s area attacks.
Aurora.combo: To catch Aurora, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. If you can all-in, follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you need movement speed to escape, stack two runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use Ryze Q Overload.
Aurora.escape: Check whether Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down before engaging. In particular, look for a chance to close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp before Aurora R Between Worlds becomes available again. Once Aurora is revealed, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Aurora.fight: Trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload right after Aurora uses a spell on the wave, then back off. While Aurora is stealthed with Aurora W Across the Veil, do not cast spells into empty space; wait for her to reappear. If Aurora still has a mobility spell available, do not go deep just because one ability is down.
Aurora.laning: Early on, scale by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hitting with Ryze Q Overload. Ryze Q Overload is blocked by minions, so use it when Aurora is outside the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so protect your CS and scaling rather than trying to kill Aurora. From mid game, his full combo becomes stronger as he gains levels and core items that increase mana. In the late game, focus on pushing the wave and using Ryze R Realm Warp to join allies or retreat after a teamfight.
Aurora.teamfight: After an ally engages, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline and deal AoE damage with Ryze Q Overload. If Aurora jumps in and no one is killed, look for a chance to root her. Aurora W Across the Veil resets when she helps kill an ally, so do not leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.watch: If you are hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, move out of its return path to avoid the second hit. The return damage increases as your health gets lower, so do not stay while cursed. After Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, leaving the area slows you, so decide whether to retreat before it appears.

Azir.build: Build a mana-granting core item first to support Ryze P Arcane Mastery and the mana his combos need. Against Azir's damage, build magic resistance rather than armor. Even with resistance, use the movement speed from Ryze Q Overload to avoid taking repeated hits where his soldiers are.
Azir.combo: To catch Azir, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to root him, then follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Ryze W Rune Prison only slows if used first, so mark him with Ryze E Spell Flux beforehand. If minions block the straight path of Ryze Q Overload, wait until Azir steps away from the wave.
Azir.escape: The opening to engage comes right after you force Azir to use Azir E Shifting Sands. At that point, from a safe position, use Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap, then root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Once Azir R Emperor's Divide is down, there's less risk of being knocked back, so look for another chance to engage.
Azir.fight: Right after Azir uses a skill on the wave, mark him with Ryze E Spell Flux and take a short trade with Ryze Q Overload when he steps away from his minions. Close the gap when the soldiers are stationary after Azir moves them with Azir Q Conquering Sands, or when Azir E Shifting Sands is down. If you can lock him down, focus damage into a short combo instead of trading with his soldiers for long.
Azir.laning: Early on, prioritize scaling over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
Azir.phase: In the mid game, build a mana-granting core item, then expand your influence with your combo and Ryze R Realm Warp. Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so don't fight his soldiers for long; focus damage when his mobility is down.
Azir.teamfight: If you bunch up in a narrow passage, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock you all back together, so enter from multiple directions in open areas. After your allies engage, spread marks across the front line with Ryze E Spell Flux and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join allies or disengage after a teamfight.
Azir.watch: Stay out of the straight line where Azir W Arise! soldiers are standing. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves the soldiers, circle beside or behind them. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back those entering and block the allies following them, so don't bunch up and enter there. Azir can cross walls with Azir E Shifting Sands, so watch for an escape route if he places a soldier near a wall.

Cassiopeia.build: Early on, build a core item that grants mana for scaling and combos. Cassiopeia's main damage is all magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor.
Cassiopeia.combo: When you have a chance to catch her, guarantee a root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Then deal damage with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you rush and use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows instead of rooting.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so engage after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is also down, cast Ryze R Realm Warp from a safe position out of vision to close the gap, then catch her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Cassiopeia.fight: Right after Cassiopeia uses a skill on the wave, take a short trade with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. When Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere, close the gap and root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison before the movement speed boost takes effect.
Cassiopeia.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Minions block Ryze Q Overload, so use it when Cassiopeia steps away from the wave. If your mana is below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
Cassiopeia.phase: In the mid game, build a mana-granting core item and make the most of one full combo. In the late game, don't take Cassiopeia's sustained damage head-on for long; look for a chance to root her.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: After your allies engage, spread marks across the front line with Ryze E Spell Flux and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Right after Cassiopeia uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison so she has no time to deal sustained damage. Cast Ryze R Realm Warp from a safe position to join your allies or disengage after a teamfight.
Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you're poisoned. Move out of range, then fight again after the poison ends. Walk out of Cassiopeia W Miasma instead of relying on Ryze R Realm Warp. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away to avoid the stun.

Corki.build: Build Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical and Ryze has low armor, so build armor first. However, resistance cannot block the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.combo: If you close in after Corki W Valkyrie is down, guarantee a root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. When committing all in, follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows.
Corki.escape: The opening to go in comes right after you force Corki to use Corki W Valkyrie. Ryze R Realm Warp activates after a brief delay, so cast it from a safe position.
Corki.fight: Early on, don't force a kill. Right after Corki uses a skill on the wave, take a short trade with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If Corki W Valkyrie is down, close the gap while his mobility is unavailable and root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Don't force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available.
Corki.laning: Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux, secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload, and focus on scaling. To keep Corki from farming comfortably, only poke briefly right after he uses a skill on the wave. If your mana is below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
Corki.phase: Corki's base stats are low during the first five levels, but Ryze also lacks mana and damage, so pressure Corki's farming with short trades while protecting your own scaling. In the mid and late game, Ryze's combo becomes strong once he has a mana-granting core item, while Corki can also pressure you with Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position after building items.
Corki.teamfight: Engage second, after your allies, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the front line, and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Don't hold your ground in front of Corki E Gatling Gun, and dodge Corki R Missile Barrage by moving out of range instead of hiding behind minions. If Corki W Valkyrie is down, look for a chance to root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around the first target, so stay out of range instead of standing behind minions. In particular, reposition to avoid repeatedly being hit by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance if it hits you, so sidestep instead of holding your ground in front of him.

Diana.build: Since Diana engages on you, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core-item build. Build magic resistance against the damage from Diana P Moonsilver Blade, Diana Q Crescent Strike, and Diana W Pale Cascade.
Diana.combo: If there is no mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. When committing all in, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Minions can block Ryze Q Overload, so hit her when she steps away from the wave.
Diana.escape: The moment Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike is your chance to catch her in return. Root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, and you can use Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap while her mobility is unavailable. Ryze R Realm Warp disappears if you are immobilized or unable to cast, so cast it from a safe position.
Diana.fight: Right after Diana uses a skill on the wave, poke briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Start a fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, create distance instead of trying to catch her.
Diana.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Diana.phase: In the mid and late game, Ryze's combo becomes strong as he builds levels and mana-granting core items, so put that scaling to use in fights.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies based on Diana's engage angle so you aren't all pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Ward the flank angle, and have Ryze join after an ally's engage tool lands. Spread marks across the front line with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it travels, so sidestep it. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so move away from the spot. Don't fight Diana up close right after she activates Diana W Pale Cascade; wait for the orbs and shield to disappear.

Ekko.build: Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core-item build in preparation for Ekko diving onto you. Build magic resistance rather than armor against his damage. Ryze has no mobility, so if the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence is a problem, prioritize tenacity over resistance.
Ekko.combo: To reliably lock down Ekko, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. When committing all in, follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you need movement speed to get away, first stack runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use Ryze Q Overload.
Ekko.escape: Even if Ekko E Phase Dive is down, don't go deep right away if Ekko R Chronobreak is still available. Look to engage when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. When using Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap, cast from a safe position because Ekko's immobilizing effect can cancel your movement if it triggers.
Ekko.fight: In lane, take a short trade right after Ekko uses a skill on the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison while his mobility is unavailable. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don't chase deep just because health is low.
Ekko.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana is below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Ekko.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize scaling over kills. In the mid and late game, one full Ryze combo becomes strong once you have a mana-granting core item. At any stage, look for fights while Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.teamfight: After your allies engage, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the front line and use Ryze Q Overload to take advantage of the spread marks. If Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to force Ekko R Chronobreak or stop his engage. Use Ryze R Realm Warp for an objective ambush with allies, to join them, or to disengage after a teamfight.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Also sidestep the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don't chase recklessly even if health is low.

Fizz.build: Since you're facing an assassin who dives in like Fizz, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass among your core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against his main damage.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, guarantee a root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. When committing all in, follow through with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows instead of rooting.
Fizz.escape: The opening to go in is after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and before it comes back. After dodging the knock-up from Fizz R Chum the Waters, use Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap, then catch him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Fizz.fight: Treat the moment after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down as your chance to counterattack, and hold Ryze W Rune Prison. Watch for Fizz Q Urchin Strike, since he has to walk into range to use it, then retaliate briefly after he engages.
Fizz.laning: Early on, protect your CS and scaling over kills, clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux, and manage your mana. Only poke briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload right after Fizz uses a skill on the wave or misses a last hit with the empowered attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident. If your mana drops below half, stop trading.
Fizz.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so focus on scaling instead of trying to fight Fizz for a kill. Ryze's full combo becomes strong in the mid and late game once he has a mana-granting core item, so increase your impact in fights then.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies to make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him together once it's down. Ryze should engage after his allies, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the front line, and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Don't chase Fizz alone.
Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts so they aren't knocked back too.

Galio.build: Ryze should first build a core item that grants mana for his early combos and scaling. Galio's main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. If you die while caught by Galio W Shield of Durand, E Justice Punch, or similar abilities, you can prioritize tenacity. When facing Galio with magic damage, consider magic penetration instead of adding only ability power.
Galio.combo: For a short poke, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Q Overload, and hit Galio when he steps away from the wave so minions don't block Q Overload. To catch him, use Ryze E Spell Flux → W Rune Prison in that order so it roots instead of slowing. When committing all in, follow with Ryze E Spell Flux → W Rune Prison → Q Overload → E Spell Flux → Q Overload.
Galio.escape: Don't engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; also look for a window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back. If Galio W Shield of Durand is down too, use Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap, then root him with E Spell Flux → W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp disappears if you are immobilized or unable to cast before it activates, so cast it from a safe position.
Galio.fight: Right after Galio uses a skill on the wave, take a short trade with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Don't spend your damage while Galio is charging Galio W Shield of Durand. Look for the window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back, but check that Galio E Justice Punch is also down before using Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap.
Galio.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Q Overload. Make Galio use skills to clear the wave, then push during the window after he has spent mana to limit his chance to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Galio.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so protect your scaling through farming instead of forcing a kill on Galio. In the mid and late game, once Ryze has the levels and a mana-granting core item, one full combo becomes strong, so look for moments when Galio's engage tools are down.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don't start a small fight with Galio's team in another lane. If you see the landing marker, leave its area. In teamfights, after your allies engage, spread marks across the front line with Ryze E Spell Flux and deal area damage with Q Overload. If Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, move out of taunt range and save your damage.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, it reduces damage taken and extends the taunt, so walk out of taunt range instead of spending Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze Q Overload into him. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch by watching for its wind-up as he steps back, and leave the overlapping gusts from Galio Q Winds of War. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, leave the area immediately.

Hwei.build: Mana is important for Ryze's damage and sustaining his combo, so build a mana-granting core item first. Build magic resistance against Hwei's damage, and get movement speed to escape telegraphed areas. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Hwei.combo: When committing all in after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Ryze W Rune Prison roots instead of slowing only if the Ryze E Spell Flux mark is on the target. If you need movement speed to get away, build two runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use Ryze Q Overload last.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so the opening to engage comes right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave. Then use Ryze R Realm Warp to close the gap and root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp disappears if you are immobilized or unable to cast before it activates, so cast it from a safe position.
Hwei.fight: Early on, focus on scaling. Right after Hwei uses a skill on the wave, take a short trade with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, close the gap and fight after rooting him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. If Hwei is behind minions, they block Ryze Q Overload, so look for a moment when he steps away from the wave.
Hwei.laning: Scale by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and securing last hits with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize CS and scaling over kills. In the mid and late game, one full combo becomes strong once you have a mana-granting core item and levels. The provided information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage at each stage against Hwei, so at any stage, look for a moment when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down.
Hwei.teamfight: After your allies engage, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the front line and use Ryze Q Overload to take advantage of the spread marks for area damage. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, your engage can be reversed or you can be rooted, so go in right after it's used. Take a wide detour around passageways covered by Hwei's ground effects, and use Ryze R Realm Warp to join allies or disengage after a teamfight.
Hwei.watch: If you are rooted or pulled in by Hwei E Subject: Torment, you can take follow-up damage, so don't engage first while this skill is available. If one of Hwei's skills hits you, reposition immediately to avoid a second skill and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Don't engage along the path of Hwei E Subject: Torment's eye if it's been placed there.

Irelia.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Ryze has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team also has an engage assassin, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier, between core items.
Irelia.combo: To catch Irelia, cast Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison in that order to root her instead of slowing her. If you can all-in, continue with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you need movement speed to escape, cast Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison to stack two runes, then use Ryze Q Overload.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, you have a window to close the gap and fight. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is down too, you’re less likely to be interrupted when approaching with Ryze R Realm Warp. Once you’re close, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses an ability on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Before Ryze R Realm Warp activates, watch for Irelia E Flawless Duet so you don’t become immobilized or unable to use abilities.
Irelia.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and preserving mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Don’t leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia, since she can use a low-health minion to dash in. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Irelia.phase: Ryze’s full combo becomes strong in the mid-to-late game, once you have core items that grant mana.
Irelia.teamfight: In team fights, focus Irelia before Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can affect several allies. After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. If Irelia approaches, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Irelia.watch: If a low-health minion is between Ryze and Irelia, she can use Irelia Q Bladesurge to dash to you repeatedly, so take a step back as the minion is about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Crossing the blade wall to get out deals extra damage and heavily slows you.

Karma.build: Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Make use of Ryze P Arcane Mastery and build core items that grant mana so you can keep up your combos in the mid-to-late game.
Karma.combo: To catch Karma, cast Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison in that order to root her. For an all-in, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Start the combo after the shield from Karma E Inspire has ended.
Karma.escape: Engage during a window when Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire is active, wait until it ends. When closing the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, cast it from a safe spot outside vision and avoid having it interrupted by Karma W Focused Resolve. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance to break it before the root takes hold.
Karma.fight: Right after Karma uses an ability on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire has ended. Once you’ve closed the gap, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Karma.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and preserving mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Ryze Q Overload is blocked by the minions in front, so use it when Karma steps out of the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage only the wave.
Karma.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so focus on farming while avoiding Karma’s poke. In the mid-to-late game, once you have core items that grant mana, Ryze’s full combo becomes strong. Look for an opening when Karma’s shield and root are down.
Karma.teamfight: Don’t engage first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available. Engage after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire has ended. After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux and use Ryze Q Overload to deal area damage. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your allies or disengage after the fight.
Karma.watch: If you keep getting hit by Karma Q Inner Flame, Karma P Gathering Fire lets her cast Karma R Mantra sooner, so position behind minions or outside its range. Immediately walk out of the area where Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame detonates. Break the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve by creating distance before the root takes hold.

Lux.build: First build core items that grant mana to secure the damage and mana Ryze needs for his combo. Build magic resistance against Lux’s magic damage, and get tenacity to prepare for being hit by follow-up attacks while rooted by Lux Q Light Binding. Movement speed is also useful for escaping the area warned by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.combo: For an all-in after Lux Q Light Binding misses, guarantee a root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, then continue with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Keep this order, since casting Ryze W Rune Prison first only slows instead of rooting. If Lux is among minions, they may block Ryze Q Overload, so look for the moment she steps out of the wave.
Lux.escape: Engage during a window after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility, so close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp and catch her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp is canceled if you’re immobilized, so cast it from a safe spot outside vision after dodging Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.fight: Right after you bait out Lux Q Light Binding and it misses is your chance to engage. Once you’ve closed the gap, mark Lux with Ryze E Spell Flux and root her with Ryze W Rune Prison so she can’t escape. If you’ve been hit by one of Lux’s abilities, don’t stay within her basic attack range while Lux P Illumination is applied.
Lux.laning: Early on, prioritize scaling over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and secure last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Only poke briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload right after Lux uses an ability on the wave, then back off. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
Lux.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize CS and scaling over trying to kill Lux. In the mid-to-late game, once you have core items that grant mana, Ryze’s full combo becomes strong.
Lux.teamfight: After an ally engages, Ryze follows as the second engager, spreading Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline and dealing area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Approach from another direction instead of grouping with allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you all together. After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, use Ryze R Realm Warp to engage with your allies or disengage after the fight.
Lux.watch: If you’re hit by Lux Q Light Binding, it’s hard to dodge her follow-up abilities, so bait out Q and move once it misses. Don’t stand in line with an ally, and leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity. When you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark, dodge sideways.

Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar’s main damage, and get core items that grant mana for Ryze’s damage and combo. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar against Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Since its damage scales with maximum health, avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Malzahar.combo: After Malzahar P Void Shift is broken, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Then deal damage with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If Void Shift is active, break it first with Ryze W Rune Prison and save the root combo for the next opportunity.
Malzahar.escape: Dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void, and engage when Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are absent or cleared. Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for an opportunity to close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp after Malzahar P Void Shift is broken. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t engage alone.
Malzahar.fight: Right after Malzahar uses an ability on the wave, poke briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Ryze W Rune Prison, then look for the next chance to engage. Once Void Shift is broken and you’ve dodged Malzahar Q Call of the Void, you can close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp.
Malzahar.laning: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so scale by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and securing last hits with Ryze Q Overload. Back off from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, and if your mana is below half, focus on managing the wave over trading. When Malzahar has pushed the lane, look for an opportunity to engage with your jungler after breaking Malzahar P Void Shift.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so protect your scaling while using wave pressure and joining up in the jungle to reduce Malzahar’s opportunities to build up. In the late game, Malzahar becomes stronger as he accumulates more, putting you at a disadvantage, so stay together while tracking Malzahar P Void Shift and Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are on the field, clear them first with the area damage from Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze Q Overload. After an ally engages, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join allies or disengage after the fight, casting it from a position where Malzahar Q Call of the Void and Malzahar R Nether Grasp can’t interrupt you.
Malzahar.watch: If a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dodge outside the line between the rifts, and don’t engage until the silence ends. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t pass through areas without vision alone.

Mel.build: Build core items that grant mana first for Ryze P Arcane Mastery and the mana needed for your combo. Build magic resistance against the damage from Mel P Searing Brilliance, Mel Q Radiant Volley, and Mel E Solar Snare.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, guarantee a root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. For an all-in, continue with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so dodge Mel E Solar Snare and engage during a window after Mel W Rebuttal is down. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate and is canceled if you’re immobilized, so cast it from a safe spot, then catch her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Mel.fight: Right after Mel uses an ability on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload.
Mel.laning: Farm and scale by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and securing last hits with Ryze Q Overload. When you can safely push, limit Mel’s chances to build stacks for Mel R Golden Eclipse. If your mana drops below half, stop fighting and manage the wave.
Mel.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so protect your farm and slow Mel’s scaling with safe pressure. In the mid-to-late game, once you have core items that grant mana, Ryze’s combo becomes strong. Mel grows stronger over time from the stacks she builds, so don’t let fights drag on.
Mel.teamfight: After an ally engages, spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux. Watch for Mel W Rebuttal reflecting projectiles, and use Ryze Q Overload to deal area damage. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to join your allies or disengage after the fight.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you’re hit at the center of the orb, so dodge to the side. If you’ve been hit by Mel’s attacks several times, watch out for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance and back off even if you still have health.

Neeko.build: Build a mana-granting core item first so you can make the most of Ryze P Arcane Mastery and keep your combos going. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst, Neeko W Shapesplitter, and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. If the usual sequence is getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then killed by Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: To reliably root Neeko, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Then all-in with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, accounting for the second Ryze E Spell Flux and its mana cost. If you need to get away, build two runes first, then use Ryze Q Overload to gain movement speed.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs goes down is your chance to engage.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down and Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable, close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, then root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; keep your eyes on the real Neeko.
Neeko.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and preserving mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. Only poke briefly right after Neeko uses a skill on the wave, and stop trading if your mana drops below half.
Neeko.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize scaling over kills. In the mid to late game, Ryze’s combos get stronger once he has a mana-granting core item, so push the wave and group up.
Neeko.teamfight: Follow up after an ally engages. Get close, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline, and deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Spread out so multiple allies aren’t caught by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. If a disguised opponent approaches, anticipate Neeko R Pop Blossom and spread out early. To stop an engage, use the root from Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits a target in front, so don’t stand in line with an ally. Neeko R Pop Blossom stuns and knocks up enemies in a large area, and its windup is hidden while she’s disguised. Spread out early if someone you suspect is Neeko approaches, and move out of range when you see the windup.

Orianna.build: Ryze P Arcane Mastery converts bonus mana into damage, so build a mana-granting core item first. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Orianna’s main damage.
Orianna.combo: If you need a root, mark the target with Ryze E Spell Flux, then use Ryze W Rune Prison. The all-in sequence is Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. When movement speed to engage or escape matters more, build two runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use Ryze Q Overload last.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no skill to create distance herself, so look for a chance to approach after Orianna W Command: Dissonance’s slow and Orianna R Command: Shockwave’s forced movement are down. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate and disappears if you’re immobilized, so cast it from a safe spot away from the ball. Once you’re close, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna uses Q Command: Attack, when the ball is away from her, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Minions can block Ryze Q Overload, so land it when Orianna steps outside the wave.
Orianna.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and preserving mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. Only poke briefly right after Orianna uses a skill on the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop fighting and manage the wave.
Orianna.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize scaling while dodging Orianna’s empowered attacks and ball. Orianna has low base defenses early, but Ryze has little reason to force a kill during this phase either. In the mid to late game, make use of the strength of a full combo as your mana core and levels build up.
Orianna.teamfight: Check the ball’s position before Orianna’s, and follow up second after an ally engages. Spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to group with allies or disengage after a fight.
Orianna.watch: Track the ball after Orianna moves it with Q Command: Attack, and avoid standing near it so you aren’t pulled in by Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Orianna W Command: Dissonance slows you, making it harder to close the gap. Early on, don’t take repeated hits from attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, and Ryze has relatively low armor, so buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items against Qiyana, an assassin who engages directly.
Qiyana.combo: To root Qiyana, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, in that order. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows her, so keep this order even when counterattacking after Qiyana’s engage is down. For an all-in, follow with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, don’t rush in; she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Engage once both mobility skills are down, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back. Close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, then root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Qiyana.fight: Don’t force a kill early. Right after Qiyana uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Once both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down, counterattack by rooting her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. If Qiyana E Audacity hasn’t come back yet, you can close the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp.
Qiyana.laning: Protect your scaling by clearing the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hitting with Ryze Q Overload. Only poke briefly right after Qiyana uses a skill on the wave. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and manage the wave.
Qiyana.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so protect your CS and scaling over going for kills. Qiyana is strongest in the mid-game, so avoid giving her an advantage throughout the early to mid-game and build armor. In the late game, Qiyana becomes relatively weaker, and Ryze’s combos get stronger once he has levels and mana-granting core items, so group with your team.
Qiyana.teamfight: Group with your team, but stand away from terrain so you aren’t all hit by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Follow up after an ally engages. Use Ryze E Spell Flux on the frontline to spread marks, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. After Qiyana engages, root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to create time to counterattack.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you when she has the river element, so move outside its range if she approaches with that element. If she disappears with the brush element, move into an ally’s vision. If you’re below half health, keep your distance from Qiyana when she has the rock element. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes on terrain and stuns, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages.

Sylas.build: Build a core item that grants mana first for early scaling and combos. Build magic resistance against Sylas’s main damage. If the enemy team has an engage assassin, move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items as well.
Sylas.combo: When countering Sylas’s engage, secure the root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Then deal damage with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If you use Ryze W Rune Prison first, it only slows, so don’t skip Ryze E Spell Flux.
Sylas.escape: Don’t engage when only Sylas W Kingslayer is down; look for a window when Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down too. After dodging the second chain, close the gap from a safe spot with Ryze R Realm Warp and root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. If you need to escape, build runes with Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, then use the movement speed from Ryze Q Overload.
Sylas.fight: Right after Sylas uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down and you’ve also dodged the chains, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison and fight. Account for the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer; don’t just chip away at his health and delay finishing him off.
Sylas.laning: Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and focus on managing the wave.
Sylas.phase: From the mid to late game, once you have a mana-granting core item, a full Ryze combo becomes strong.
Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison and focus him before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. After an ally engages, follow up as Ryze by spreading Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline and dealing area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to group with allies or disengage after a fight.
Sylas.watch: Against Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, watch out for the chains that follow the first dash. If they hit, you’ll be knocked up and hit by his combo, so watch for and dodge the second action. If Sylas Q Chain Lash clips you, immediately leave the intersection where it explodes later.

Syndra.build: Buy boots early to gain the movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Build magic resistance first for defense, but also get health to prepare for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power. Ryze P Arcane Mastery converts bonus mana into damage, so secure the mana you need to scale.
Syndra.combo: When you have an engage window after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, secure the root with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, then follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. The second Ryze E Spell Flux applies a new mark to amplify the final Ryze Q Overload. Ryze Q Overload stops at the first target it hits, so use it when Syndra steps out from among the minions.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-peel and has a long cooldown, so the moment it goes down is your chance to engage. When closing the gap with Ryze R Realm Warp, cast from a safe spot since the cast can be canceled by effects that immobilize you or prevent you from casting abilities. After you arrive, root Syndra with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Syndra.fight: Right after Syndra uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, avoid the line of orbs, close the gap, and root her with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
Syndra.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and scaling over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and focus on managing the wave.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize farming over kills. In the mid to late game, a full combo deals more damage as your mana-granting core and levels build up. When Syndra’s skill effects change, adjust your spacing to account for the increased power or range of her empowered abilities.
Syndra.teamfight: Follow up after an ally engages. Spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. Use Ryze R Realm Warp to group with allies or disengage after a fight.
Syndra.watch: Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, and Syndra R Unleashed Power can execute low-health targets. The danger from Syndra R Unleashed Power increases where several orbs are on the ground, so move away.

Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Talon’s physical damage early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor, but also get health to account for Talon’s flat armor penetration. Move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items if you need time to survive his engage, and consider penetration against Talon’s high magic resistance.
Talon.combo: To catch Talon, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to root him rather than slow him. If you can all-in, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. When movement speed to escape matters more, build runes with the first two skills and use Ryze Q Overload last.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy is your window to close the gap. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate, so start it from a safe spot without vision. After arriving, root Talon with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. It’s even better to counterattack if you’ve confirmed Talon R Shadow Assault is also down.
Talon.fight: Right after Talon uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. Right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy, you have a chance to close the gap. Cast Ryze R Realm Warp from a safe spot, then follow up with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison to look for a root.
Talon.laning: Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload, but stop trading if your mana drops below half.
Talon.phase: Early on, Talon’s burst is strong and Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize CS and survival over kills. In the mid-game, Ryze’s combo becomes stronger as he gains levels and a mana-granting core item, so push the lane, then look for chances to group with allies. Talon’s influence falls off late, so group with your team to fight.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon dives into your backline, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison so it overlaps with your allies’ crowd control. Don’t go in recklessly first; follow up after your allies engage, spread Ryze E Spell Flux across the frontline, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. After the fight, you can use Ryze R Realm Warp to disengage with your allies.
Talon.watch: Talon W Rake builds passive stacks if it hits both on the way out and on the way back, so if the first hit lands, move out of the return path. Watch for engages with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and Talon E Assassin’s Path. If Talon R Shadow Assault is still available, don’t chase recklessly, since he can go invisible.

TwistedFate.build: Mana contributes to Ryze’s damage and lets him keep his combo going, so prioritize a mana-granting core item. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Twisted Fate’s damage.
TwistedFate.combo: If you have a chance to catch him, root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, then follow with Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Ryze W Rune Prison without Ryze E Spell Flux only slows, so don’t change the order when you need a root.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your engage window. While Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, you can also approach with Ryze R Realm Warp and root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. Ryze R Realm Warp takes time to activate and disappears if you’re immobilized, so don’t enter gold card range while it is ready.
TwistedFate.fight: Right after Twisted Fate uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. If the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has been used or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, you can close the gap and engage with Ryze R Realm Warp.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and preserving mana over kills. Clear the wave with Ryze E Spell Flux and last-hit with Ryze Q Overload. Reduce the poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions, and stop trading if your mana drops below half.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so prioritize scaling over kills.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Follow up after an ally engages. Spread marks across the frontline with Ryze E Spell Flux, then deal area damage with Ryze Q Overload. If Twisted Fate has used the gold card, look for a chance to root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate locks in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range.

Veigar.build: Ryze needs mana to maintain his combos and damage, so build a mana-granting core item first. The resistance you need against Veigar’s damage is magic resistance, not armor. If you often get trapped in Veigar E Event Horizon and hit by his combo, consider tenacity first.
Veigar.combo: To root Veigar, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison, in that order. For an all-in, use Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison → Ryze Q Overload → Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload. Ryze Q Overload can be blocked by minions, so look for the moment Veigar steps outside the wave.
Veigar.escape: The window to engage opens after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Close the distance with Ryze R Realm Warp, then root him with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze W Rune Prison. If you’re trapped inside Veigar E Event Horizon, don’t run into the edge. When using Ryze R Realm Warp to escape, make sure you aren’t stunned and have your cast canceled.
Veigar.fight: Right after Veigar uses a skill on the wave, trade briefly with Ryze E Spell Flux → Ryze Q Overload, then back off. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down, look for a chance to close the distance and engage with Ryze R Realm Warp. Keep moving during fights so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
